about_the_game:
🏆 Backstage Football

The backstage of professional football, finally in your hands.

In Backstage Football, you are not the coach — you are the sporting director.
Recruit, negotiate, plan, influence — everything happens behind the scenes.

Take control of a professional club and manage every aspect of its success:

  • Player signings and contract renewals

  • Negotiations with agents and sponsors

  • Recruitment of staff (coaches, scouts, analysts…)

  • Development of youth academy and facilities

  • Marketing strategy, merchandise, fans and club image

  • Choose the next manager and approve key transfers

Then, watch realistic 3D matches, study tactics and player performances to guide your next decisions.
Every choice affects your finances, team chemistry and club reputation.

🎯 Main Features:

  • Full club management: finances, staff, transfers, facilities

  • Realistic 3D match engine

  • Reputation and relationship systems (media, fans, players, board)

  • Dynamic events and random scenarios (injuries, media pressure, internal crises)

  • Modern, intuitive scouting and management interface

  • Sandbox mode for total freedom

  • Progress from small clubs to global dominance

Football isn’t just a game — it’s a business.
Welcome behind the scenes.
Welcome to Backstage Football.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 ou AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX
  • Additional Notes: Nécessite une résolution minimale de 1080p

short_description: Manage transfers, staff, and finances like a real sporting director. Backstage Football takes you behind the scenes of professional football. Football isn’t just a game — it’s an empire to build. Take control of the club and decide everything… except the score.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
